name: mnemosyne
description: Aman's mnemosyne plugins. Private: installs only for accounts that can read this repository.

plugins.name: mnemosyne
plugins.description: The mnemosyne-cards skill (card canon, golden set, review page workflow), the mnemosyne-tutor skill (tutoring from what Aman's Anki shows he knows), the mnemosyne-books skill (quoting, citing, and practice problems from his own textbooks), the mnemosyne-clips skill (Manim clips for /watch in his house style, rendered on the Obelisk), the mnemosyne-exam skill (exam prep from his lectures, practice exams, and memory: probes, cram sheet, worked solutions, review guide, his own formula sheet or the provided one explained), and the mnemosyne-weekly skill (the weekly audit: what the week's cards show, and changes he approves).
